mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.avatar AS userAvatar, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content AS content, c.like_count AS likeCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comment sub WHERE sub.parent_id = c.id AND sub.status = 0 AND sub.deleted = 0 ) AS replyCount, c.create_time AS createTime FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0 AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.avatar AS userAvatar, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content AS content, c.like_count AS likeCount, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comment sub WHERE sub.parent_id = c.id AND sub.status = 0 AND sub.deleted = 0 ) AS replyCount, c.create_time AS createTime FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0 AND c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
